classes.name: benefit corporation
classes.label: benefit corporation
classes.definition: not-for-profit corporation set up under specific state legislation, typically to provide some social benefit, without an obligation to maximize shareholder return

classes.name: board agreement
classes.label: board agreement
classes.definition: formal, legally binding agreement between members of the Board of Directors of the organization

classes.name: common interest development corporation
classes.label: common interest development corporation
classes.definition: not-for-profit corporation set up under specific state legislation as a business entity for homeowners' associations

classes.name: corporation
classes.label: corporation
classes.definition: formal organization that is a legal entity (artificial person) distinct from its owners, created under the jurisdiction of the laws of a state or nation

classes.name: for profit corporation
classes.label: for profit corporation
classes.definition: corporation whose objective is to make money, i.e., to ensure realization of a financial benefit such that the amount of revenue gained from a business activity exceeds the expenses, costs and taxes needed to sustain that activity

classes.name: incorporation guarantee
classes.label: incorporation guarantee
classes.definition: guarantee that is part of the financial basis by which some legal entity is incorporated

classes.name: instrument of incorporation
classes.label: instrument of incorporation
classes.definition: memorandum and articles of association by which some legal entity is established

classes.name: joint stock company
classes.label: joint stock company
classes.definition: for-profit, unincorporated business that has some characteristics of a corporation and some features of a partnership, with ownership interests represented by shares of stock

classes.name: not-for-profit corporation
classes.label: not-for-profit corporation
classes.definition: corporation approved by its jurisdictional oversight and tax authorities as operating for educational, charitable, social, religious, civic or humanitarian purposes

classes.name: privately held company
classes.label: privately held company
classes.definition: corporation whose issued shares are all held by a family or a small group of investors and, therefore, cannot be bought by the public

classes.name: publicly held company
classes.label: publicly held company
classes.definition: corporation whose shares are traded and held publicly

classes.name: registration identifier
classes.label: registration identifier
classes.definition: identifier that is officially allocated to an organization at the time of registration, typically in a jurisdiction in which said organization is organized or registered and used in that jurisdiction to identify the organization

classes.name: registration identifier scheme
classes.label: registration identifier scheme
classes.definition: scheme that defines the registration identifier per the issuing registration authority

classes.name: religious corporation
classes.label: religious corporation
classes.definition: not-for-profit corporation whose objective is specific to some fundamental set of beliefs and practices generally agreed upon by a number of people, and that is incorporated under the law

classes.name: stock corporation
classes.label: stock corporation
classes.definition: corporation that has shareholders, each of whom receives a portion of the ownership of the corporation through shares of stock

classes.name: branch
classes.label: branch
classes.definition: part of a larger organization that might not be co-located with it

classes.name: division
classes.label: division
classes.definition: part of an organization, such as a line of business, that may have separate accounting and reporting requirements

classes.name: joint venture
classes.label: joint venture
classes.definition: legal entity that is formed between parties that pool their resources for the purpose of accomplishing a specific task but otherwise retain their distinct identities

classes.name: non-governmental organization
classes.label: non-governmental organization
classes.definition: not-for-profit organization that functions independently of government

classes.name: not for profit organization
classes.label: not for profit organization
classes.definition: organization that uses its surplus revenues to further achieve its purpose rather than distributing its surplus income to the organization's owners (directors, investors, and equivalents) as profit / dividends

classes.name: organization covering agreement
classes.label: organization covering agreement
classes.definition: contract between the principals in a formal organization that specifies the relationship between the principals, and between the principals and the entity

classes.name: value-added tax identification number
classes.label: value-added tax identification number
classes.definition: tax identifier that identifies a taxable person (business) or non-taxable legal entity for a consumption tax that is assessed incrementally, levied on the price of a product or service at each stage of production, distribution, and sale to the end consumer

classes.name: business entity
classes.label: business entity
classes.definition: entity that is formed and administered as per commercial law in order to engage in business activities

classes.name: business license
classes.label: business license
classes.definition: license that allows the holder to conduct business or carry out a specific profession within some jurisdiction for some period of time

classes.name: chartered legal person
classes.label: chartered legal person
classes.definition: a legal person created by a royal charter or decree

classes.name: legally competent natural person
classes.label: legally competent natural person
classes.definition: person who is considered competent, under the circumstances, to enter into a contract, conduct business, or participate in other activities that generally require the mental ability to understand problems and make decisions on his or her own behalf

classes.name: not for profit objective
classes.label: not for profit objective
classes.definition: objective that reflects the charitable, educational, religious, humanitarian, public services, or other not for profit goals of an organization

classes.name: power of attorney
classes.label: power of attorney
classes.definition: legal authorization given by one party (the principal) to another (the agent or attorney-in-fact) to perform certain acts on the principal's behalf

classes.name: profit objective
classes.label: profit objective
classes.definition: objective that reflects pursuit of a financial benefit that may be realized when the amount of revenue gained from a business activity exceeds the expenses, costs and taxes needed to sustain that activity

classes.name: public purpose
classes.label: public purpose
classes.definition: objective that reflects values generally thought to be shared by and that is intended to benefit the populace as a whole

classes.name: religious objective
classes.label: religious objective
classes.definition: not-for-profit objective that reflects the religious goals of an organization

classes.name: fonds commun de placement
classes.label: fonds commun de placement
classes.definition: legal entity created to fulfill narrow, specific, and frequently temporary objectives

classes.name: statutory body
classes.label: statutory body
classes.definition: legal entity established by a government to consider evidence and make judgements in some field of activity

classes.name: variable interest entity
classes.label: variable interest entity
classes.definition: legal entity whose shareholders are entitled to a percentage of a named company's profits via a private contract

classes.name: accounting framework
classes.label: accounting framework
classes.definition: framework, including policies, methods, rules, and processes, used to measure, recognize, present, and disclose the information appearing in an entity's financial statements, and, from a legal ownership perspective, that is applied for accounting consolidation determination

classes.name: contractually capable entity
classes.label: contractually capable entity
classes.definition: a unique entity that is legally or financially responsible for the performance of financial transactions, or has the legal right in its jurisdiction to enter independently into legal contracts, regardless of whether it is incorporated or constituted in some other way (e.g. trust, partnership, contractual). This excludes natural persons, but includes governmental organizations and supranationals.

classes.name: entity legal form
classes.label: entity legal form
classes.definition: a classifier for a legal entity that indicates the nature of that entity as defined from a legal or regulatory perspective, in the jurisdiction in which it was established

classes.name: entity legal form identifier
classes.label: entity legal form identifier
classes.definition: code that denotes an entity legal form as defined in ISO 20275

classes.name: entity legal form scheme
classes.label: entity legal form scheme
classes.definition: scheme that specifies the elements of the codes for entity legal forms, such as those that are sanctioned in a given jurisdiction as defined in ISO 20725

classes.name: LEI registered entity
classes.label: LEI registered entity
classes.definition: a legal person that has registered for and is identified by a legal entity identifier

classes.name: legal entity identifier
classes.label: legal entity identifier
classes.definition: an organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal person as defined in ISO 17442

classes.name: legal entity identifier scheme
classes.label: legal entity identifier scheme
classes.definition: a scheme that specifies the elements of an unambiguous legal entity identifier (LEI) scheme to identify the legal entities relevant to any financial transaction

classes.name: relationship period qualifier
classes.label: relationship period qualifier
classes.definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the reporting period specified, such as that the date period reflects an accounting or document filing period

classes.name: relationship qualifier
classes.label: relationship qualifier
classes.definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period, such as the accounting framework used

classes.name: relationship record
classes.label: relationship record
classes.definition: a record describing relationships between legal entities

classes.name: relationship status
classes.label: relationship status
classes.definition: a classifier that specifies the status of the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period (active or inactive)

edges.name: has date of incorporation
edges.label: has date of incorporation
edges.definition: indicates the formal date of incorporation as stated in filing documents

edges.name: has date of registration
edges.label: has date of registration
edges.definition: indicates the date on which the corporation has registered in some jurisdiction for regulatory and / or for tax purposes

edges.name: has issued capital
edges.label: has issued capital
edges.definition: indicates the aggregate value of all shares held by shareholders

edges.name: is constituted by
edges.label: is constituted by
edges.definition: the instrument by which an entity is incorporated

edges.name: is incorporated in
edges.label: is incorporated in
edges.definition: the legal jurisdiction under which the legal entity is incorporated

edges.name: has equity
edges.label: has equity
edges.definition: indicates owners' equity associated with the entity

edges.name: has headquarters address
edges.label: has headquarters address
edges.definition: indicates the main address at which communications may be delivered for the organization

edges.name: has operating address
edges.label: has operating address
edges.definition: indicates an address at which an organization carries out operations

edges.name: has registered address
edges.label: has registered address
edges.definition: identifies an address that is officially recorded with some government authority and at which legal papers may be served

edges.name: has intended liquidation date
edges.label: has intended liquidation date
edges.definition: links an agreement, contract, or legal entity to a date on which it is scheduled to be sold

edges.name: has legal address
edges.label: has legal address
edges.definition: indicates the legal address for the entity, in the jurisdiction in which the entity is established, used for registration purposes with respect to obtaining an LEI

edges.name: has legal form
edges.label: has legal form
edges.definition: indicates the nature of the entity as defined from a legal or regulatory perspective in a given jurisdiction

edges.name: is consolidated by
edges.label: is consolidated by
edges.definition: indicates the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) from an ISO 17442 perspective

edges.name: is consolidation of
edges.label: is consolidation of
edges.definition: indicates the entity considered the 'start node' or consolidated entity from an ISO 17442 perspective

edges.name: is directly consolidated by
edges.label: is directly consolidated by
edges.definition: indicates that the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) fully consolidates the accounting of the 'start node' (child) per the accounting rules specified, and is the closest consolidating entity to that child in any applicable ownership hierarchy

edges.name: is an international branch of
edges.label: is an international branch of
edges.definition: indicates that the entity considered the 'start node' or consolidated entity (child) is an international subsidiary of the 'end node' (parent) in the jurisdiction of the child

edges.name: is ultimately consolidated by
edges.label: is ultimately consolidated by
edges.definition: indicates that the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) fully consolidates the accounting of the 'start node' (child) per the accounting rules specified, and is the most distant consolidating entity to that child in any applicable ownership hierarchy

attributes.name: has shares authorized
attributes.label: has shares authorized
attributes.definition: indicates the maximum number of shares that are permitted to be issued, as established by the board of directors

attributes.name: has legal form abbreviation
attributes.label: has legal form abbreviation
attributes.definition: the precise abbreviation for the entity legal form as defined in the jurisdiction in which it is registered, for example LLC, LLP, Ltd, PLC, Corp.

attributes.name: has ownership percentage
attributes.label: has ownership percentage
attributes.definition: the percentage ownership interest in the owned entity owned by owning entity, if known

attributes.name: has transliterated legal form abbreviation
attributes.label: has transliterated legal form abbreviation
attributes.definition: a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) representation of the abbreviation for the entity legal form

attributes.name: has transliterated name
attributes.label: has transliterated name
attributes.definition: a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) representation of a name for the entity

attributes.name: is quantified by
attributes.label: is quantified by
attributes.definition: indicates that something is limited to or conditional due to some rate or other statistical value
